title: Calculating crosstabs
text: data modified applying commands following sheets (using datadaptor::Mapping$modify_data() hood): Variables: modifies data set’s variables labels. Label: modifies data set’s variables’ value labels allows generate summary variables. Free1: allows define additional commands modifying data. modifications Variables & Label sheets also done . See documentation commands used sheets.

title: Calculating crosstabs
text: following sheets control, crosstabs calculated: Macro: allows define additional header variables x-axis crosstabs. Questions: rows table define crosstabs calculated.

title: Calculating crosstabs
text: can apply data modifications calculate crosstabs one command constructing R6 object class “Tabula”:
code: m <- crosstabser::Tabula$new(   dat = df,    mapping_file = mapping_file )

title: Calculating crosstabs
text: Instead using Excel mapping file, can also define mapping entirely R without need Excel file passing relevant data list:
code: mapping_file <- list(   Variables = Variables,   Label = Label,   Free1 = Free1,   Questions = Questions,    # You can pass the parameters of the data.frame    # in the `Macro` sheet as a named list:   Macro = list(ColVar = ColVar) ) m <- crosstabser::Tabula$new(   dat = df,    mapping_file = mapping_file )

title: Parameters in the Questions sheet
text: arguments Type RowVar need specified crosstabs: cat: single-choice questions; multiple RowVars specified, generate multiple crosstabs (along y-axis) variable labels RowVars sub-title mw: item batteries questions, e.g. “Rank item scale 1 – 5.”; First table created showing mean values RowVar variables lines, “Summary means” table. , series tables showing frequency counts categorical variables generated similar case cat, “detail tables”. mdg: multiple dichotomy group (called MDGROUP SPSS); multiple-choice question; answer option one variable; text choice variable label accdording variable; answer selected variable usually value 1. mcg : multiple category group (called MCGROUP SPSS); multiple-choice question; alternative way mdg code multiple choice questions. answer possibilities stored value labels (every variable value labels). means, need least many variables maximum number choices selected respondents. RowVar: variable names tabulated (space-separated); alternatively, string starts prefix "ts: " (without quotes), can use tidy-select syntax afterwards

title: Parameters in the Questions sheet
text: Title: Question title shown table; blank single quotes (' ') inserts line break Abbreviation: identifier string internal use; duplicated specified, "_row_<ROW VALUE>" appended (<ROW VALUE> row number) Unguelt: values / variable names ("mdg") representing unvalid cases Filter: logical expression cases filtered; can also use different expressions multiple RowVars; translates string containing (multiple occurences ): prefix_{[|B|...]}_suffix multiple strings prefix_A_suffix, prefix_B_suffix, prefix_..._suffix prefix_{rowvar}_suffix multiple strings RowVars replacing "{rowvar}" part(s) string Multiple SelVars multiple Filters allowed throw error. SelVar & SelVal: calculates table(s) conditionally every value SelVal Variable SelVar takes, variables RowVar mentioned many times number variables SelVar. Format SelVal: “1 2 3 4:Name_it_different 2-97:All_others” produce table values 1 4 one 2-97 combined labelled “others”. Mult: TRUE SelVar/SelVal interviews counted double, SelVar SelVal (.e. SelVar two “manufacturers” mentioned, seen two answers) Weight: variable values weighted (overwrite one set sheet Macro existing)

title: Generate Crosstabs of Labelled Data Sets with Excel Files
text: main home repository goal crosstabser generate crosstabs labelled data (usually survey data). parent dependency datadaptor uses similar approach modify datasets. generated crosstabs can plotted interactively html files apps provided table_charter. can find interactive introduction also shows resulting table_charter app can dynamically created data crosstabser. package (together datadaptor) also used generate crosstabs table books (commercial product).

title: Generate Crosstabs of Labelled Data Sets with Excel Files
text: First ’ll load package. Now, suppose survey data df. data consists 3 cases answers Yes & stored variable q1 age category stored variable age. suppose want generate crosstab, summarizing values q1 y-axis, x-axis showing total counts, well sub-populations variable age. crosstabser allows define mapping object like : can calculate crosstabs print console: Please refer vignette("crosstabser") thorough introduction, vignette("questions-parameters") details use parameters mapping. vignette("data-format") closer look structure crosstabs’ underlying data.
code: library(crosstabser) df <- tibble::tibble(   q1 = c(1, 2, 1) |> haven::labelled(c(Yes = 1, No = 2), label = "Super important question"),   age = c(2, 1, 1) |> haven::labelled(c("18-39" = 1, "40+" = 2), label = "age") ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   q1        age       #>   <dbl+lbl> <dbl+lbl> #> 1 1 [Yes]   2 [40+]   #> 2 2 [No]    1 [18-39] #> 3 1 [Yes]   1 [18-39] (mapping_file = list(   Questions = data.frame(     Type  = "cat",     RowVar = "q1",     Title = "The crosstab's title"   ),   Macro = list(ColVar = "age") )) #> $Questions #>   Type RowVar                Title #> 1  cat     q1 The crosstab's title #>  #> $Macro #> $Macro$ColVar #> [1] "age" Tabula$new(df, mapping_file) #> $`2` #> $`2`[[1]] #> # The crosstab's title #>                            TOTAL age   ----- #>                                  18-39 40+   #> TOTAL                abs     3       2     1 #> Yes                  abs     2       1     1 #>                      in %   66.7    50   100 #> No                   abs     1       1     0 #>                      in %   33.3    50     0 #> VALID CASES          abs     3       2     1 #>                      in %  100     100   100
